beats.journal: I've cleared the pirates out of the <Place>. Now I need to spoil their store, which is still full.
I opened the pirates' store at the <Place> to the weather and cut the seals on every crate. Whatever they come back for won't be worth carrying.
beats.name: Pirate Store
say: That's the store spoiled. With nowhere to keep it, they'll stop taking our runs.

broadcast: Every run we lose ends up in the same place. Clear it out and spoil what's in there. If they've nowhere to keep it, they stop taking it.
